## Other models and venue coverage

[GAM, Stan, Glicko-2, and TrueSkill ratings](models_t20i.qmd) use their own scales
and show uncertainty. The contextual models use verified venue countries from
the reusable [cricket grounds bridge](https://github.com/outside-edge/cricket_grounds).
A separate resolution step fills missing countries, preserves the original values,
and records the evidence in the downloadable
[match-level audit](../out/release/models/t20i/venue_audit.csv).
The [upstream diagnosis](https://github.com/outside-edge/side_order/blob/main/docs/current_models.md#t20i-upstream-diagnosis)
explains why the archival ground table left gaps.
